etymology.historical_story: Diggle is documented by Saddleworth Parish Council as a village name. That establishes a geographical use, but does not establish the origin of the name or identify the source of this lowercase corpus token. Treating it as a Malay root would add unsupported information. Its historical derivation remains unverified in this entry.
